Agent skills for designers and builders using Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other AI coding agents

Agent Skills

A curated collection of agent skills for designers and builders using Codex, Claude, Cursor, and other AI coding agents to build rich user interfaces, playable games, frontend systems, agent loops, automations, and reusable workflows.

Use these skills with Codex, Claude Design, Aura Build, Lovable, and the rest of your agent stack to turn references into prompts, generate detailed landing pages, build playable Three.js systems, and create reusable implementation workflows.

Start with the flagship web-design workflow:

  1. Video to Super Prompt Turns a screen recording of a design, landing page, or animation into a super detailed prompt that Fable 5 can use to one-shot HTML.
  2. HTML to Interaction Prompts Turns an existing HTML page, like an Aura Build page, into reusable prompts for one section, one animation, one button, one hover state, or one WebGL effect.
  3. Stitched Full Page Capture Captures the entire landing page instead of only the hero, giving your agent a full-page reference for structure, pacing, and visual hierarchy.
  4. Daily UI Inspiration Combines browsing, capture, reference study, and prompt generation into a useful agent loop that turns strong landing pages into detailed prompt packs.

These are portable agent skill folders: concise SKILL.md playbooks with optional references, articles, scripts, and assets. The goal is simple: turn good prompts, workflows, style systems, capture recipes, and debugging habits into versioned files an agent can load and follow.

Portable by default. Each skill should work for any user, repo, or workspace unless the user supplies project-specific context through local agent instructions.

Browse all runnable demos and recreation prompts.

Explore the 3D rendering skills for ultra-realistic water, underwater god rays, virtual tours, sky rays, sky backgrounds, falling leaves, four seasons, detailed textures and models, and Retina rendering at 200%.

Explore the illustration skills for 14 hand-written SVG illustration styles, from flat and outlined cartoon to halftone, one-line, isometric and vintage emblem, each with example cards, a palette, a drawing kit and a render-and-lint loop.

Use these skills when you want:

  • repeatable design direction
  • reusable game architecture and gameplay QA
  • procedural implementation steps
  • copy/paste snippets
  • common pitfalls and guardrails
  • reusable workflows instead of one-off chat answers

Agent support

The format is intentionally plain Markdown and folder-based.

  • Codex: load the relevant SKILL.md before acting. Repo behavior belongs in AGENTS.md; browser work in this repo should use the Codex browser.
  • Claude Code: reference the relevant skill from CLAUDE.md, copy it into a Claude skills setup, or open the SKILL.md directly as working context.
  • Cursor: point Cursor rules or chat context at the specific skill folder. Keep reusable snippets, constraints, and defaults easy to paste.
  • Other agents: use the same contract: read the narrowest matching skill first, then follow its steps and linked references.

Philosophy

1) Prompts are assets

If it’s good once, it should be reusable.

  • store prompts as files
  • version them
  • build libraries + stylecards

2) Specs beat vibes

The fastest way to consistent output is:

  • clear constraints
  • clear hierarchy
  • “change 1–2 things only” iteration

3) References beat paragraphs

Screenshots and examples carry:

  • fonts, spacing, colors
  • layout rhythm
  • icon style

4) Skills are operating procedures

Good skills tell the agent exactly when to use them, what to do first, what defaults to apply, and what mistakes to avoid.

  scripts/            # optional: helper scripts
  demo/               # optional: visual or interaction proof
    index.html         # standalone HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
    PROMPT.md          # exact recreation and remix prompts
    assets/            # local demo assets when required

Conventions:

  • SKILL.md is the skill an agent loads and follows.
  • REFERENCES.md is links only. Keep SKILL.md lean.
  • Visual and interaction skills may include a portable demo/index.html and demo/PROMPT.md.
  • Workflow skills may include fictional demo/input.md and demo/expected-output.md handoffs when they materially improve proof.
  • Keep skills procedural (steps, patterns, guardrails), not encyclopedic.
  • Prefer explicit triggers: "Use when..." beats vague descriptions.
  • Prefer defaults: durations, spacing, hierarchy, commands, and acceptance checks.

Workflow (4)

How to work with agents on a real project: the rules repeated in every thread, turned into procedures with scripts. See the workflow guide.

  • workflow-progress-screenshots - send real screenshots of the start, key moment and result as work progresses, unasked, with headless capture and side-by-side scripts.
  • workflow-score-to-target - score work out of 10 on an anchored rubric, judge it independently, and improve round by round until every item hits the target.
  • workflow-ship-change - ship every change: screenshots, changelog, tests, own files only, fast-forward push, draft-then-live publish, measured sizes and a 50 MB stop.
  • workflow-threads-manager - oversee many agent threads on one repo: what merged, what's live, what's missing from the changelog, what to archive, what got cut off.

How to add a new skill (workflow)

  1. Create a folder:
  • agent-skills/<category>/<skill-name>/
  1. Add SKILL.md:
  • frontmatter: name, description
  • content: when to use, workflow, pitfalls, recipes, what to ask
  1. Add a portable demo when visual or interaction proof is useful:
  • demo/index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript
  • demo/PROMPT.md with minimal, recreation, and remix prompts
  • local files under demo/assets/
  1. (Optional) add REFERENCES.md:
  • doc links only
  1. Test the skill contract:
  • clear trigger
  • concrete workflow
  • reusable snippets or commands
  • pitfalls and acceptance checks
  • no secrets or private client info
  1. Commit:
  • small commits per skill
  • clear message, usually Add <skill-name> skill or Update <skill-name> skill

Writing style

  • Write like Meng To: skimmable, practical, confident.
  • Prefer constraints and defaults.
  • Avoid fluff.
  • Keep long explanations in ARTICLE.md, not SKILL.md.
  • Keep references in REFERENCES.md, not the workflow.

Maintenance ideas

  • Keep category README files current as the library grows.
  • Add install notes for Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor once the preferred setup is stable.
  • Add lightweight validation for required frontmatter.
  • Keep imported skills portable: no secrets, no private paths, no hidden account assumptions.

内置两套视觉系统:

  • Style A: 电子杂志 × 电子墨水。像 Monocle 贴上了代码,适合叙事、观点、分享、个人风格表达。

旧主题 · Style A 电子杂志风

  10. 迭代 — 根据排练结果调整内容、字号、高度和间距

演讲者模式

两套模板都内置同一套演讲者运行时。打开 deck 后,点击右下角 P 即可进入演讲者视图；浏览器会同时打开一个干净的观众屏。所有核心能力都在本地 HTML 和浏览器里完成,不依赖实时字幕、云端中继、手机遥控或 AI 教练服务。

演讲者视图示例

演讲时能看到什么

  • 当前页与下一页:上下排列并始终保持 16:9,小屏时整页等比缩放,不裁切、不挤压文字
  • 宫格选页:在预览区原位切换总览,点选页面后立即回到双预览,观众屏同步跟随
  • 结构化备注:标题、本页目的、讲述要点和转场必填；互动、语气、翻页时机、备用方案和读音等信息只在大纲提供时显示
  • 进度与状态:显示当前页 / 总页数、完成百分比,以及观众屏的连接中、已同步、未同步、已冻结、未连接或弹窗被拦截状态

时间、排练与自动翻页

  • 底栏分别显示已进行、本页和剩余 / 超时时间,按钮明确区分“开始计时 / 继续计时 / 重置计时”
  • 排练模式记录每页实际时长和整场汇总,数据保存在本地浏览器,不会做 AI 评分
  • 自动翻页默认关闭；只有大纲明确给出页面停留秒数,或用户在设置中开启全局间隔时才启用
  • 打开宫格、设置、圈选工具,页面隐藏,或观众屏暂停 / 失去同步时,自动翻页会暂停

现场工具与故障恢复

  • 激光笔、圈选和清除会同步到观众屏
  • 一键黑屏、白屏,或冻结观众屏；恢复后自动追平演讲者当前页
  • 观众窗口关闭或心跳超时后明确显示“未连接”,可随时点击“重新打开观众屏”
  • 退出演讲时自动关闭观众窗口；浏览器不允许自关时,观众端显示“演示已结束”
  • 演前检查覆盖弹窗、全屏、字体、图片 / 视频和 16:9 预览,并提醒人工确认 HDMI、转接器和投影仪

常用快捷键：← / → 翻页,Home / End 跳首页或尾页,G 宫格,L 激光笔,C 圈选,B / W 黑屏或白屏,F 冻结观众屏,? 查看完整快捷键。

Style B 瑞士风

瑞士风是这次新增的结构化主题。它不是"换一套 CSS",而是一套更严格的版式系统。

  • 22 个具名版式:正文页只能从 S01 到 S22 中选择,不能临时发明页面结构
  • 4 套锚点色:克莱因蓝 IKB、柠檬黄、柠檬绿、安全橙
  • 网格锁定:16 列 grid、直角色块、1px 发丝线、无阴影、无渐变、无圆角
  • 中文字号收敛:全中文大标题需要降一档,避免占掉正文和图片空间
  • 图文底对齐:左文右图 / 左图右文场景优先让正文块与图片底部对齐,同时避开页脚翻页组件
  • 图片槽位绑定:图片必须进入模板预留的 data-image-slot,常见主图按 21:9 或 16:10 生成
  • 强校验:用脚本拦住居中标题、实验版式、SVG 内写字、图片脱离槽位等问题;可用 Playwright 时还会量化真实渲染后的 overflow、bottom whitespace、title gap

瑞士风校验命令:

node scripts/validate-swiss-deck.mjs path/to/index.html

Codex 配图能力

在 Codex 环境中,完成 deck 初稿后可以主动询问用户是否需要生成配图。用户确认后,再询问图片类型或风格,常用类型包括:

  • 人文纪实照片:富士 / 徕卡感的真实场景,增加人文表现力
  • 信息图 / 流程图 / 对比图 / 系统关系图:用于解释无法用实拍照片说明的概念
  • 截图美化 / 截图再设计:原始截图优先用内置背景资产做 CleanShot X 式背景画布适配;需要重构时再生成 UI 情景图
  • 数据大字报 / 数据图表:把关键数字做成可直接插入 PPT 的视觉素材
  • 多图拼贴:用于极宽图片槽位,避免把三张 16:9 图片硬塞进三列

生成图片时要遵守四个关键规则:

  • 图片是 PPT 中的嵌入素材,不要自带页脚、页底、标题、角标、页码或装饰边框
  • 图片语言跟随 deck 语言:中文 deck 的信息图用中文标签,英文 deck 用英文标签
  • 图片比例必须先匹配落位:瑞士风主图常用 21:9,通用主图常用 16:9 / 16:10,截图再设计常用 16:10,多图网格统一高度
  • 用户截图需要保真时,先读 references/screenshot-framing.md,用 assets/screenshot-backgrounds/ 内置背景 + 程序化缩放/留边/对齐处理,不要默认重画截图内容

配图提示词见 references/image-prompts.md,截图适配见 references/screenshot-framing.md。

核心设计原则

  1. 克制优于炫技 — WebGL 背景只在 hero 页透出
  2. 结构优于装饰 — 信息靠字号 + 字体对比 + 网格留白,不用阴影和浮动卡片
  3. 图片是第一公民 — 图片要对齐正文内容区,比例稳定,只裁底部,顶部和左右完整
  4. 配图只做素材 — 生成图只保留核心照片 / 图表 / UI,不要把 PPT 页脚、标题和角标画进图片里
  5. 节奏靠 hero 页 — hero / non-hero 交替,才不累眼睛
  6. 低性能可退场 — 按 B 能切换到静态模式,动态效果不能成为阅读负担
  7. 术语统一 — Skills 就是 Skills,不中英混译
  8. 瑞士风必须守版式 — Style B 优先还原原始 22P 版式,不要为了"多样"发明不存在的页面

视觉参考

  • Monocle 杂志的版式
  • YC Garry Tan "Thin Harness, Fat Skills"
  • Massimo Vignelli / Helvetica Forever / 瑞士国际主义网格系统
  • 歸藏线下分享 PPT 系列

Roadmap

  • 补充更多真实案例和可打开的 HTML deck 示例
  • 扩展封面规格,覆盖更多内容平台
  • 增加更多瑞士风版式校验规则
  • 优化截图再设计和信息图生成工作流
  • 整理 WorkBuddy 等平台上架版本
  • 增加更多主题包,品牌色继续走受约束生成

FAQ

可以导出 PPTX 吗? 当前核心交付是 HTML。你可以用浏览器演示、截图或录屏。如果需要 PPTX,建议把 HTML 页面作为视觉稿再转换,但这不是当前主流程。

为什么不允许自定义颜色? 这个 Skill 的重点是稳定产出。自由选色很容易破坏整体风格,所以只允许从预设主题里选。需要品牌色时用 scripts/gz-theme.mjs 生成,它会按风格约束明度和彩度,并检查每个文字角色的对比度。

我能加自己的版式吗? 可以。Style A 可以在 references/layouts.md 里扩展；Style B 更严格,需要同步更新 template-swiss.html、layouts-swiss.md、swiss-layout-lock.md 和校验器。

Codex 配图是必须的吗? 不是。没有配图也能生成 PPT。配图流程只在需要照片、信息图、UI 情景图或封面时使用。

演讲者模式需要联网或额外服务吗? 不需要。双窗口同步、备注、计时、排练、自动翻页和标注都在本地浏览器完成。它不会提供实时字幕、手机遥控或 AI 排练评分。

为什么关掉观众窗口后显示“未连接”? 演讲者端会通过观众屏确认和心跳判断软件链路。窗口关闭或心跳超时会显示“未连接”,点击“重新打开观众屏”即可恢复。浏览器无法判断 HDMI 或投影仪线缆是否真的接通,现场仍需目视确认。

怎么更新到最新版? 重新运行安装命令,或在本地 skill 目录执行 git pull。

贡献

Bug、排版问题、新布局需求——欢迎开 Issue 或 PR。改动请优先:

  • 在 template.html 里补类,不要让 layouts.md 使用未定义的类
  • 在 template-swiss.html 里补类时,同步更新 layouts-swiss.md 和 swiss-layout-lock.md
  • 瑞士风新增规则后,同步更新 scripts/validate-swiss-deck.mjs
  • 演讲者运行时必须同时更新两套模板,并运行 scripts/check-presenter-runtime-sync.mjs；CI 会拦截两份模板的 CSS / JavaScript 漂移
  • 演讲备注或现场行为变化时,同步更新 references/presenter-mode.md、references/checklist.md 和 scripts/validate-presenter-mode.mjs
  • 把踩过的坑写到 checklist.md 对应的 P0 / P1 / P2 / P3 级别
  • 主题、字号、字体和背景特效来自共享设计系统,模板里 GZ:FONTS / GZ:TOKENS / GZ:EFFECTS 区块和 themes*.md 的 GZ:THEMES 区块是生成的,不要手改;新主题色或字号调整请提 Issue

item.title: plannotator/effective-html
item.description:
Agent skills for useful HTML artifacts, wireframes, interactive prototypes, plans, and diagrams.

https://plannotator.ai

Effective HTML

简体中文

Focused agent skills for creating useful, self-contained HTML artifacts, from low-fidelity wireframes to working interactive prototypes.

Fat artifacts + fat context

Modern models can do a lot. Give them plenty of useful references and use artifacts to show what you mean. HTML can visualize almost anything, often more clearly than a wall of text. Your prompt can simply point to the artifacts, repositories, and folders that carry the context.

Note

You can use this repo without installing anything. Treat it as a reference first and an installable skill collection second. See the Effective HTML guide.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/24306977-7f30-44c9-9bff-55f901d557b0

Render and annotate local HTML with Plannotator.

Skill references

The repo includes eight optional skills for pragmatic visual artifacts.

Skill Use it for
html Broad HTML requests, mixed artifacts, reports, explainers, presentations, landing pages, tools, and routing to a specialist
big-pics-little-words Explain the current subject in HTML with large visuals and minimal text while preserving key details; copied from bro
one-pager Make a one-pager: one HTML page that shares an idea with teammates early, or recaps work for them, with big pictures and little words; copied from bro
design-artifact Subject-specific creative direction for any HTML artifact without imposing a reusable house style
html-wireframe Low-fidelity layout directions that test content, hierarchy, navigation, flows, and responsive structure
html-prototype Working prototypes with realistic states, interaction, keyboard support, and responsive behavior
html-plan Plans, roadmaps, rollouts, and implementation sequences that preserve source commitments
html-diagram Architecture, sequence, process, state, hierarchy, timeline, and system diagrams

Practical guide: HTML Wireframes and Prototypes for Coding Agents.

Install

Install the collection when you want these references available to your agent as reusable workflows:

npx skills add plannotator/effective-html

List or install individual skills:

npx skills add plannotator/effective-html --list
npx skills add plannotator/effective-html --skill big-pics-little-words
npx skills add plannotator/effective-html --skill one-pager
npx skills add plannotator/effective-html --skill design-artifact
npx skills add plannotator/effective-html --skill html-wireframe
npx skills add plannotator/effective-html --skill html-prototype

Claude Code plugin

/plugin marketplace add plannotator/effective-html
/plugin install plannotator-effective-html@effective-html

Codex plugin

codex plugin marketplace add plannotator/effective-html
codex plugin add plannotator-effective-html@effective-html

How the skills work

The skills separate creative freedom from reliability:

  • Visual direction comes from the conversation, project, audience, and subject.
  • design-artifact provides a reusable design process without prescribing a reusable look.
  • Wireframes stay intentionally unfinished so reviewers focus on structure.
  • Prototypes implement one credible flow and its relevant states.
  • Plans preserve source commitments.
  • Diagrams choose a visual model and rendering method that fit the relationship being explained.
  • Every artifact is responsive, accessible, self-contained, and verified in a browser.

Detailed guidance lives only where it is needed. The broad html skill routes the work, design-artifact supplies optional creative direction, and specialist skills own fidelity and behavior. Each skill remains independently usable.

This project was inspired by Thariq Shihipar's The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML.

item.title: dequelabs/axe-core
item.description:
Accessibility engine for automated Web UI testing

https://www.deque.com/axe/

axe-core

Axe is an accessibility testing engine for websites and other HTML-based user interfaces. It's fast, secure, lightweight, and was built to seamlessly integrate with any existing test environment so you can automate accessibility testing alongside your regular functional testing.

Sign up for axe news to get the latest on axe features, future releases, and events.

The Accessibility Rules

Axe-core has different types of rules, for WCAG 2.0, 2.1, 2.2 on level A, AA and AAA as well as a number of best practices that help you identify common accessibility practices like ensuring every page has an h1 heading, and to help you avoid "gotchas" in ARIA like where an ARIA attribute you used will get ignored. The complete list of rules, grouped WCAG level and best practice, can be found in doc/rule-descriptions.md.

With axe-core, you can find on average 57% of WCAG issues automatically. Additionally, axe-core will return elements as "incomplete" where axe-core could not be certain, and manual review is needed.

To catch bugs earlier in the development cycle we recommend using the axe-linter vscode extension. To improve test coverage even further we recommend the intelligent guided tests in the axe Extension.

If you build with an AI coding agent, the Axe MCP Server gives your agent the official axe-core rules to scan with as it works. It's free to use, built by the team that maintains axe-core. Paid tiers extend it with advanced rules, automated Intelligent Guided Tests, and shared configuration across teams and organizations.

Getting started

First download the package:

npm install axe-core --save-dev

Or, using pnpm:

pnpm add --save-dev axe-core

Now include the javascript file in each of your iframes in your fixtures or test systems:

<script src="node_modules/axe-core/axe.min.js"></script>

Now insert calls at each point in your tests where a new piece of UI becomes visible or exposed:

axe
  .run()
  .then(results => {
    if (results.violations.length) {
      throw new Error('Accessibility issues found');
    }
  })
  .catch(err => {
    console.error('Something bad happened:', err.message);
  });

Philosophy

The web can only become an accessible, inclusive space if developers are empowered to take responsibility for accessibility testing and accessible coding practices.

Automated accessibility testing is a huge timesaver, it doesn't require special expertise, and it allows teams to focus expert resources on the accessibility issues that really need them. Unfortunately, most accessibility tools are meant to be run on sites and applications that have reached the end of the development process and often don't give clear or consistent results, causing frustration and delays just when you thought your product was ready to ship.

Axe was built to reflect how web development actually works. It works with all modern browsers, tools, and testing environments a dev team might use. With axe, accessibility testing can be performed as part of your unit testing, integration testing, browser testing, and any other functional testing your team already performs on a day-to-day basis. Building accessibility testing into the early development process saves time, resources, and all kinds of frustration.

About axe - our Manifesto

  • Axe is open source.
  • It returns zero false positives (bugs notwithstanding).
  • It's designed to work on all modern browsers and with whatever tools, frameworks, libraries and environments you use today.
  • It's actively supported by Deque Systems, a major accessibility vendor.
  • It integrates with your existing functional/acceptance automated tests.
  • It automatically determines which rules to run based on the evaluation context.
  • Axe supports in-memory fixtures, static fixtures, integration tests, and iframes of infinite depth.
  • Axe is highly configurable.

Supported Browsers

The axe-core API fully supports the following browsers:

  • Microsoft Edge v40 and above
  • Google Chrome v42 and above
  • Mozilla Firefox v38 and above
  • Apple Safari v7 and above
  • Internet Explorer v11 (DEPRECATED)

Support means that we will fix bugs and attempt to test each browser regularly. Only Chrome and Firefox are currently tested on every pull request.

There is limited support for JSDOM. We will attempt to make all rules compatible with JSDOM but where this is not possible, we recommend turning those rules off. Currently the color-contrast rule is known not to work with JSDOM.

We can only support environments where features are either natively supported or polyfilled correctly. We do not support the deprecated v0 Shadow DOM implementation.

Contents of the API Package

The axe-core API package consists of:

  • axe.js - the JavaScript file that should be included in your web site under test (API)
  • axe.min.js - a minified version of the above file

Localization

Axe can be built using your local language. To do so, a localization file must be added to the ./locales directory. This file must be named in the following manner: <langcode>.json. To build axe using this locale, instead of the default, run axe with the --lang flag, like so:

pnpm run build -- --lang=nl

This will create a new build for axe, called axe.<lang>.js and axe.<lang>.min.js. If you want to build all localized versions, simply pass in --all-lang instead. If you want to build multiple localized versions (but not all of them), you can pass in a comma-separated list of languages to the --lang flag, like --lang=nl,ja.

To create a new translation for axe, start by running pnpm run translate -- --lang=<langcode>. This will create a json file in the ./locales directory, with the default English text in it for you to translate. Alternatively, you could copy ./locales/_template.json. We welcome any localization for axe-core. New locales need a review by a native-speaking accessibility expert before we can accept them; see locales/README.md. For details on how to contribute, see the Contributing section below. For details on the message syntax, see Check Message Template.

To update an existing translation file, re-run pnpm run translate -- --lang=<langcode>. This will add new messages used in English and remove messages which were not used in English.

Additionally, locale can be applied at runtime by passing a locale object to axe.configure(). The locale object must be of the same shape as existing locales in the ./locales directory. For example:

axe.configure({
  locale: {
    lang: 'de',
    rules: {
      accesskeys: {
        help: 'Der Wert des accesskey-Attributes muss einzigartig sein.'
      }
      // ...
    },
    checks: {
      abstractrole: {
        fail: 'Abstrakte ARIA-Rollen dürfen nicht direkt verwendet werden.'
      },
      'aria-errormessage': {
        // Note: doT (https://github.com/olado/dot) templates are supported here.
        fail: 'Der Wert der aria-errormessage ${data.values}` muss eine Technik verwenden, um die Message anzukündigen (z. B., aria-live, aria-describedby, role=alert, etc.).'
      }
      // ...
    }
  }
});

Supported Locales

Axe-core supports the following locales. Do note that since locales are contributed by our community, they are not guaranteed to include all translations needed in a release.

  • Azerbaijani
  • Basque
  • Chinese (Simplified)
  • Chinese (Traditional)
  • Danish
  • Dutch
  • French
  • German
  • Greek
  • Hebrew
  • Italian
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Norwegian (Bokmål)
  • Polish
  • Portuguese (Brazilian)
  • Spanish
  • Swedish

Updates & Security

Axe-core has a new minor release every 3 to 5 months, which usually introduces new rules and features. We recommend scheduling time to upgrade to these versions. Security updates will be made available for minor version lines up to 18 months old.

  • See release and support for details on the frequency of releases, long-term support and recommendations on upgrading axe-core.
  • See backward compatibility for details on the types of changes different releases may introduce.

Deque Trademarks Policy

DEQUE, DEQUELABS, AXE®, and AXE-CORE® are trademarks of Deque Systems, Inc. Use of the Deque trademarks must be in accordance with Deque's trademark policy.

Supported ARIA Roles and Attributes.

Refer axe-core ARIA support for a complete list of ARIA supported roles and attributes by axe.

Contributing

Read the Proposing Axe-core Rules guide

Read the documentation on the architecture

Read the documentation on contributing

Projects using axe-core

List of projects using axe-core

Acknowledgements

Thanks to Marat Dulin for his css-selector-parser implementation which is included for shadow DOM support. Another thank you to the Slick Parser implementers for their contribution, we have used some of their algorithms in our shadow DOM support code. Thanks to Lea Verou and Chris Lilley for their colorjs.io library which we have used for converting between color formats.

item.title: sdli1995/dlssg_for_sm86
item.description:
Here is a dlssg for RTX30 Series GPU

DLSSG for SM86（代理版）- 0.4.2 版本

中文 · English

在 RTX 30 系列（SM86）和 RTX 20 系列（SM75）上启用 NVIDIA DLSS 帧生成（DLSS-G），并提供 RTX 30 / 20 上的 DLSS 超分 INT8 加速。Windows x64 / D3D12，运行文件为 version.dll、dlssg_sm86.ini 和 dlssg_sm86\ 目录。

从 0.3.x 升级先看这里：0.4.0 是大版本升级，文件结构和安装方式都变了，不能直接覆盖。

  1. 先删干净旧版：退出游戏，删掉游戏目录里本项目的全部代理 DLL（0.3.1–0.3.6 让复制了 version.dll、winmm.dll、dbghelp.dll、dinput8.dll 四个，四个都要删）、dlssg_sm86.ini 和整个 dlssg_sm86\ 目录。
  2. 再复制新版的三样：version.dll、dlssg_sm86.ini、整个 dlssg_sm86\ 目录。运行库、后端、内核包、XeSS 模型包和超分文件都在 dlssg_sm86\ 里，只复制 DLL 什么都不会发生。
  3. 代理任何时候只放一个：根目录只有 version.dll；游戏不加载它时，从 alternatives\ 换一个（换，不是加）。
  4. 用新的 dlssg_sm86.ini：键的位置变了（Optimized、Preset 移到 [DLSSG]，新增 [XeSSFG]），[Runtime] Mode=Auto 已删除。旧位置的 Optimized / Preset 不再读取：只写在旧位置且不是默认值（例如旧 INI 的 [FrameGeneration] Optimized=1）时帧生成不启用并记一条 configuration_invalid；改过的设置请在新 INI 里重新改。

详细步骤见下文「安装与升级」和安装手册 MANUAL.html。

本次更新说明

0.4.2

  • XeSS-FG 在 RTX 50（Blackwell）上的性能修复：0.4.1 给 RTX 40 / 50 的是 compute_75 PTX，ptxas 在 sm_120 上把每条 m8n8k16 编成一条完整 m16n8k16、一半结果丢弃（主干卷积 144 条 vs 72 条、寄存器 79 → 124），Blackwell 的张量核内核因此比 Ampere 形状慢约一倍。0.4.2 给 26 个内核单独编 .bw 镜像（compute_86 PTX + 3×3 抽头配对成 m16n8k32），并把 RTX 50 上跑 DXIL 更快的 dispatch 收缩到 D25 与 model 15 的 D02 / D30。赛博朋克 2077 3440×1440（RTX 5070）：4X 每真实帧 6.54 → 4.68 ms、真实帧率 46.5 → 52.0 fps；2X 2.43 → 1.69 ms（57.8 → 59.8 fps）；同卡 DLSS 4X 为 3.98 ms。
  • XeSS-FG 支持抖动运动矢量（DLSSG.MvecJittered=1）：3X / 4X 不再以 xefg_kernel_fatal{unsupported_input} 结束——D31 改跑 4 个 jt_ 内核，携带 model 18 的抖动项 D = (jp − jc) · (1 − t)；不带抖动时与普通路径逐位相同。代价约每生成帧 +0.08 ms（1440p RGBA8）、4K +0.17 ms。
  • 4K 优化：model 18 的 D24 / model 15 的 D29 的 MV splat 换成本项目自己的 CUDA 内核；散射缓冲只清「本次或上次散射可能写到的前缀」。4K 每真实帧再快 3.0–5.6 %，输出逐位不变。
  • 新增 dlssg_sm86ini_Configurator.html：单文件、无外部依赖的 INI 配置器——按分区编辑常用键、实时预览生成的 INI、载入现有 INI（选择或拖放）、下载 / 复制、中英切换，并内置校验（MaxGeneratedFrames 1–5、Engine=XeSS 只能 1–3、旧 Model= 键提示等）。随发行包一起发布。
  • [XeSSFG] UseHudless=Auto 改为与 0 相同：无论游戏是否提供 HUD-less 画面，后缓冲都作为网络输入，整幅画面（含 UI）一起插值（不再产生 xefg_hudless_unused）；1 仍是严格档（缺可用的 HUD-less 画面即 xefg_kernel_fatal{hudless}）。键的取值与出厂值不变（Auto）。
  • 版本号 0.4.2；README / MANUAL / INSTALL / COMPAT 同步更新（COMPAT 新增 C139）。

0.4.1

  • XeSS-FG 引擎（可选）：
    • 多帧生成（MFG）：[FrameGeneration] Engine=XeSS 做到 2X / 3X / 4X（MaxGeneratedFrames 1–3）。模型是 MFG-Unlocker 1.6.0 移植的 Intel model 15：2X 仍是 model 18 的图（比原来多 4–5 %），3X / 4X 走 model 15 自己的多帧路径，每个真实帧的第 i 张生成帧用相位 t = i / (N + 1)。[XeSSFG] Model 键删除（只有一个模型），旧 INI 里写了只记一条告警。
    • 张量核 CUDA 后端：移植版的主干层（3×3 INT8 卷积）是手写的 INT8 IMMA 内核（mma.sync.m16n8k16），权重用 cp.async 双缓冲预取；整套图由本项目自己的 D3D12 + NVAPI CUDA 运行器在游戏的命令列表上执行，不加载 Intel 的 libxess_fg.dll。
    • [XeSSFG] FlowResolution=CoarseAt4K：输出像素数 ≥ 3840 × 2160 时自动 Coarse，1440p 仍 Middle。
    • [XeSSFG] UseHudless 改为三态：Auto（出厂，逐帧判断）/ 1（严格：缺 HUD-less 即拒绝）/ 0（不用）。
    • 在 RTX 30 上：1440p 及以下比 DLSS-G 快 8–15 %，4K 起慢 27–30 %，见「性能」。
  • [SuperResolution] Mode 改为显式预设：Off（出厂）/ M-INT8 / L-INT8 / M-FP16 / L-FP16；0.4.0 的 Mode=On 删除，非法值是 configuration_invalid、超分不启用。
  • [DLSSG] Preset 只剩 A / B / C：Auto 删除（按 A 跑），出厂 A。
  • 一批键删除、不再读取：旧位置的 [FrameGeneration] Optimized / [Compatibility] OptimizedKernels / [Compatibility] Preset、[Compatibility] AccelerateNewerGpus / ForceGeneratedFrames / SM75Family / HardwareBilinear / LaunchChains / PlainVariant、[Backends] 等；写了只记一条告警，行为按出厂值。RTX 40 / 50 一律跑本项目的内核。
  • 驱动要求变成硬性 R580：CUDA 13 构建的 cubin 被驱动拒绝时不再改跑 PTX，直接报错并拒绝帧生成（driver_below_floor / kernel_image_unavailable）。
  • 超分 INT8 首帧卡顿修复：12 张权重镜像的上传移出第一个观察帧（此前那一次 Evaluate 的 CPU 时间比同预设 FP16 多 5–6 ms）。
  • 显式开关做不到就拒绝，不再静默回退：[Runtime] Path / SRPath 指错文件、随包文件缺失、RTX 40 / 50 上 KernelImage=Cubin 等，都拒绝并写清原因。
  • 日志：只有一个文本日志 dlssg_sm86\logs\dlssg_sm86.log（0.4.0 的每进程 frames_<pid>.jsonl 取消）；[Logging] FrameTiming=1 另写 frame_timing.txt。

0.4.0

  • 超分 INT8（只限 RTX 30 / 20）：[SuperResolution] Mode=On 后，游戏用预设 L / M 的超分档位（多数游戏是「性能」和「超级性能」）换成本项目的 INT8 内核，预设不变。RTX 3070 上一次超分的 GPU 时间对同预设 FP16：L −6..−16 %，M −9..−22 %。出厂 Mode=Off。（Mode=On 2026-10-19 删除，现为 M-INT8 / L-INT8 / M-FP16 / L-FP16。）
  • DLSS-G 预设 C（FG Lite，可选）：[DLSSG] Preset=C。每个生成帧不跑第二个网络与后处理，RTX 3070 真实抓取上每生成帧 GPU 时间 2X −29..−34 %、4X 约 −45 %，画质略低（主要在 HUD 与遮挡边缘）。出厂仍是 Preset=Auto（Auto 2026-10-22 已删除，出厂改为 A）。

安装与升级

第一次装 mod 的，照发布包根目录的安装手册 MANUAL.html（英文版 MANUAL.en.html，双击用浏览器打开）一步一步做。简要步骤：

  1. 完全退出游戏。
  2. 进入游戏实际渲染的 EXE 所在目录（如《黑神话：悟空》为 ...\b1\Binaries\Win64\）。不确定是哪个目录时，在游戏运行时打开任务管理器的「详细信息」，右键游戏进程 →「打开文件所在的位置」。
  3. 把发布包根目录的 version.dll、dlssg_sm86.ini 和 dlssg_sm86\ 这个文件夹复制进去；该目录已有同名 DLL 时先备份原文件。运行库、后端、内核包、XeSS 模型包和超分 snippet 都在 dlssg_sm86\ 里，代理本身不到 1 MB，只复制 DLL 不复制文件夹会什么都不发生。alternatives\ 平时不用复制。
  4. 启动游戏，在图形设置中开启 DLSS 帧生成，选 2X / 3X / 4X（要 6× 见下面「6X 说明」，需要手动把 MaxGeneratedFrames 改成 5）。RTX 20 / 30 上原来灰掉的帧生成选项现在能打开，就说明装上了。
  5. 要确认代理确实被加载（RTX 40 / 50 的帧生成本来就能开，只能这样确认）：把 [Logging] Level 改成 2，开着帧生成玩一会儿再退出，dlssg_sm86\logs\dlssg_sm86.log 里有这个游戏 EXE 名的行就是加载了（这个文件也保留以前各次运行的行，看这一次的）。出厂 Level=1 只在出错时写日志，logs 是空的或者没有这个目录都是正常的。
  6. 游戏不加载 version.dll（Level=2 下开了帧生成，dlssg_sm86.log 里也没有这个 EXE 名的行）：退出游戏，删掉它，从 alternatives\ 按 winmm.dll → dbghelp.dll → dinput8.dll → dxgi.dll → d3d12.dll 的顺序一次换一个放到 EXE 旁再试。任何时候只放一个；dxgi.dll 和 d3d12.dll 在渲染路径上，最后才用，两个不要同时放。说明见 alternatives\README.md。
  7. 升级：退出游戏，先删掉旧的代理 DLL、dlssg_sm86.ini 和 dlssg_sm86\ 目录，再复制新版这三样；改过的设置在新 INI 里重新改。0.3.1–0.3.6 让把 version.dll、winmm.dll、dbghelp.dll、dinput8.dll 四个代理都复制过去，升级时四个都要删：同一目录里有几个本项目的代理时，进程里第一个被加载的那个运行本 mod，抢到的若是旧版本，跑的就是旧版本。从 0.3.x 升级的人还可以删掉 %LOCALAPPDATA%\DlssgSm86——新版不再往那里写任何东西。
  8. 卸载：删掉 version.dll（换过的就删换上的那个）、dlssg_sm86.ini 和 dlssg_sm86\ 目录，备份过的原 DLL 放回去。

出厂 dlssg_sm86.ini 里玩家可能要改的开关：

  • [DLSSG] Optimized：一致性档位 0–3。出厂 1 = 全部逐位一致的加速（2026-10-21 起；0.4.0 出厂是 2）；2 = 再加有损图像内核：不再与官方逐位一致，对着真值并排看与 1 没有可见差别，每生成帧快 1–3 %；0 为原厂数值；3 为全部有损加速。2026-10-14 之前在 [FrameGeneration]，旧位置不再读取（见上面第 4 条）。
  • [DLSSG] Preset：出厂 A；这里写什么就跑什么，游戏或驱动配置要 B / C 也不变（Auto 已删除，写了按 A 并记一条告警）；B = 强制 UI 重组（游戏同时交出无 HUD 画面与 UI 平面时才有效）；C = FG Lite（更快，画质略低），同样用本项目的加速内核（随 Optimized 档位），游戏自带哪个版本的 DLSS-G 都能用。
  • [FrameGeneration] MaxGeneratedFrames：出厂 3 对应 4X；改成 5 对应 6X。这是要求而不是上限：原样告诉游戏（驱动 profile 压不低它），游戏菜单可以选更低的倍率；做不到时（超过 5、Engine=XeSS 时超过 3）帧生成不启用并在日志里说明（max_generated_frames_unsupported），不会悄悄降。
  • [FrameGeneration] Engine：出厂 DLSS；XeSS = Intel XeSS-FG 模型（model 15，2X 走 model 18 的图）：MaxGeneratedFrames 可以是 1–3，出厂的 3 直接可用；[XeSSFG] Model 键 2026-10-26 删除，写了不读。[XeSSFG] FlowResolution（出厂 Middle，越细越慢）与 UseHudless（出厂 Auto = 与 0 相同：整幅画面含 UI 一起插值；1 = 一律要求，游戏没给就报错退出）只对 XeSS 生效。

插帧后帧率怎么估算

先在相同场景、输出分辨率、DLSS 超分档位与画质设置下关闭帧生成，得到帧率 F_off。用 1000 / F_off 换算基础帧时间，再从上表按分辨率、倍率与内核配置选整组插帧耗时 T_FG（ms）。

基础帧时间   T_base (ms) = 1000 / F_off
帧组时间     T_group (ms) ≈ T_base + T_FG
真实帧/帧组速率 G (组/s)  ≈ 1000 / T_group
插帧后总帧率 F_out (FPS)  ≈ G × M = 1000 × M / (1000 / F_off + T_FG)

M 为倍率（2X…6X 对应 2…6）。一组含一个真实帧与 M − 1 个生成帧；上表的 T_FG 已包含整组生成帧与共用预处理，不能再乘 M − 1。开启插帧后的真实帧/帧组速率 G 低于关闭插帧的 F_off。

6X 说明

6X（每真实帧生成 5 帧）为 NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 的 Dynamic Multi Frame Generation。随包的运行库支持该能力，本项目使其能在 Ampere 上运行（只限 Engine=DLSS）。

出厂 MaxGeneratedFrames 是 3（4X），6X 需要自己改。 原因是自带 Dynamic MFG 的游戏会默认直接跑到这里写的数，5 对多数人偏高（公开仓库 issue #497 / #499）；把它改回 5 随时可以拿到 6X。是否真的得到 6X 还取决于游戏：

  • 游戏自身支持 6X（自带较新的 Streamline 帧生成插件、菜单中可选 6X 或 Dynamic MFG）：把 MaxGeneratedFrames 改成 5 即可，实测可稳定运行 6X。
  • 游戏仅支持 4X（自带较旧的 4X 插件，当前多数游戏如此）：上限由游戏侧插件决定，本项目无法将其抬到 6X（该插件在初始化时按 4X 铺设内部呈现队列，强行加帧会越界导致帧生成失效或崩溃）。这类游戏请使用 4X。

实测反馈

《黑神话：悟空》、《赛博朋克 2077》与《极限竞速 地平线 6》实测可正常开启 4X；《A Plague Tale: Resonance》在帧生成选「动态 / 自动」时默认跑 6X。0.4.0 在 RTX 3070 上于这四款与《巫师 3》共五款游戏中各跑过 DLSS 默认、预设 C 与 XeSS（2X、4K 输出），没有崩溃、TDR 或设备移除，截图中 HUD 完整。插帧观感依赖基础帧率：基础帧率偏低时可能出现画面破坏与边缘效应，倍率越高越明显，部分游戏即使 4X 也需适当降低画质设置、把基础帧率抬高后才有较好观感；这是帧生成在帧率余量不足时的固有表现，非本项目缺陷。

已知问题

  • XeSS-FG（Engine=XeSS）是可选项，默认仍是 DLSS-G。在 RTX 30 上它每生成帧比 DLSS-G 慢得多（4K：RTX 3070 +77..+86 %、约 +3 ms，RTX 3080 Ti 离线 +109..+114 %），真实帧率低 8..15 %，《A Plague Tale: Resonance》低 28 %（多出的等待原因未查明）；显存多约 0.4–0.5 GB；Engine=XeSS 到 4X（MaxGeneratedFrames 1–3），写 4 以上帧生成不启用（max_generated_frames_unsupported）。HUD-less 开 / 关的画质差别还没有做逐帧对比。XeSS 下 [Debug] Capture 录不到东西。
  • XeSS-FG（model 15）的开销（RTX 3070，离线完整路线回放，Middle、DIRECT，每个真实帧连同它的生成帧的 GPU 毫秒数）：4X 时 1440p 4.5–5.0 ms，DLSS 默认 5.3–5.4 ms（快 8–15 %）；4K 10.3–10.8 ms，DLSS 默认 7.9–8.5 ms（慢 27–30 %）；预设 C 在所有档上最快。2X 走 model 18 的图，比原来的 Model=18 多 4–5 %（5070 游戏内实测 +1.7 %，输出逐位相同）（多拷上一帧的深度，用无 HUD 画面时再加后缓冲）。这是离线 GPU 时间，不等于游戏帧率。黑神话：悟空 4K（R10G10B10A2、无 HUD 画面）游戏内真实帧率：3X 32.0 fps（DLSS 默认 34.0），4X 28.5 fps（DLSS 默认 31.5）。画质只在 4 段抓取上对跳帧真值比过：靠近上一真实帧的序号（t = 1/4、1/3）上重影比 model 18 + t 少，但不是每个场景都更好。
  • XeSS 跑不了时不改跑 DLSS-G：游戏声明的后缓冲不是 R8G8B8A8 / B8G8R8A8 / R10G10B10A2（例如 HDR 常用的 RGBA16F；Intel 自己的 XeSS-FG 也不接受这种格式）或 XeSS 的对象建不出来时，插帧特性被拒绝（插帧关，错误级 xefg_feature_refused）；运行中才发现的问题（缺后缓冲、深度、运动矢量或插帧输出，尺寸不一致，录制失败）记一条错误级 xefg_kernel_fatal 写明原因，游戏以 0xE0D55001 退出。出厂 UseHudless=Auto 等于 0（2026-11-10 起，C139），整幅画面含 UI 一起插值，不再出现 xefg_hudless_unused；UseHudless=1 时这是 xefg_kernel_fatal，游戏以 0xE0D55001 退出。
  • [DLSSG] Preset=B（强制 UI 重组）只在游戏同时提供 HUD-less 画面与 UI 平面时生效，多数游戏不提供；这时日志（出厂级别）记一条 preset_ineffective 写明缺哪张，画面与不写 Preset=B 相同。
  • 游戏自带的是代 A 的 DLSS-G 运行库（≤ 3.8.x、旧版 Streamline 插件，只能驱动 2X；例如巫师 3 次世代版、光明记忆、蜘蛛侠重制、原子之心、三角洲）时，2026-10-19 起帧生成不启用，游戏的请求原样转发（日志错误级 game_runtime_generation）；此前这些游戏能开 2X。
  • 预设 C 没有与 RTX 40 / 50 上官方预设 C 的对照；巫师 3 上预设 C 每生成帧快 1 ms 但帧率不变（瓶颈在别处）。
  • [FrameGeneration] CatmullRomWarp 在 310.9.16 包上没有对应的内核行：写了就拒绝帧生成（日志错误级 detail_restore_row_unknown；2026-10-20 之前只是不生效）。实验性的 DetailRestore*、[Compatibility] LaunchChains / PlainVariant / ChainBlock0 / HardwareBilinear、[Runtime] CacheDirectory、[Debug] QueueTrace 2026-10-21 删除，2026-10-26 起不读（写了与没写相同）。
  • 显式开关做不到时一律拒绝而不是换路径（2026-10-20）：[Runtime] Path / SRPath 指错文件、随包的运行库或超分 snippet 缺失（此前分别回退随包 / 交回游戏自己的那份，RTX 40 / 50 上就是原生 2X）、RTX 40 / 50 上 KernelImage=Cubin（kernel_image_unavailable）；超分安装失败时这次 nvngx_dlss.dll 的加载被拒绝，游戏里 DLSS 不可用而不是跑原厂 FP16。拒绝之后游戏菜单怎么表现没有在真实游戏里看过。
  • 超分：Mode 把 M / L 钉在所有档位，画质 / 平衡 / DLAA 档因此比游戏自己的 K 慢（业主接受）；0.4.0 的 Mode=On（只加速游戏本来就用 L / M 的档）已删除。
  • RTX 20：310.9.16 的三个新内核与 XeSS 只在 RTX 3070 上做过 sm_75 前向 JIT 验证，在真 Turing 上没有跑过；超分 INT8 在 2080 Ti 上做过一次冒烟。RTX 40 / 50：帧生成的 PTX 路线没有实机运行过。
  • 游戏被强关等不正常退出时，后端不写 XeSS 的汇总记录（xefg_summary，只影响诊断）。

诊断与边界

  • 日志写入游戏目录 dlssg_sm86\logs\dlssg_sm86.log：所有模块、所有进程都追加写这一个文件，每行先是本地时间、pid N、EXE 名和级别字母（E = Level 1 / I = 2 / D = 3），再是 JSON 记录，例如 2026-10-22 14:03:11.482 pid 12345 Cyberpunk2077.exe E {"event":...}；只看一个游戏时按 EXE 名或 pid 过滤（Select-String / findstr）。FrameTiming=1 时另有普通文本 frame_timing.txt，每个进程追加一段。默认 [Logging] Level=1 只记错误，排查时改 2 或 3。
  • 帧生成未生效时先看日志里是否有 install.active=true 且 backend_install.status=0；缺失多为驱动/运行库不匹配，会记录原因；安装失败时 nvngx_dlssg.dll 的加载被拒绝、帧生成不启用（runtime_selection_failed），不再改用游戏自己的运行库。
  • 帧生成开着却一帧都不生成：看日志里有没有 foreign_fg_mod——有就是游戏里还装着别的插帧 mod（rtx-encore、OptiScaler、旧版的 ReShade 伴随插件等），只留一个。游戏崩溃时日志末尾的 fg_gate_crash 写着崩在哪个模块（ours 表示是否本项目的代码），反馈问题时请附上。
  • 离线耗时下降不能当成实测游戏 FPS 增幅；实际帧率增益取决于游戏与瓶颈所在。
  • INI 全部键、日志字段与录制回放见 docs/INSTALL.md、docs/CAPTURE.md。

SM75 来源与致谢

  • Coldwood1026 的 RTX 20 系列 / SM75 适配（SM75 内核族的来源，见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt）。
  • NVIDIA 的 DLSS-G 运行库、DLSS 超分 snippet、模型与前后处理（随包、未经修改）。
  • Intel 的 XeSS-FG 模型（着色器与权重，MIT 许可，见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt）。
  • MFG-Unlocker 1.6.0（Michael Robles / dashdogy，MIT）：XeSS-FG 用的 model 15 移植程序与帧数解锁的做法；其中 46 个程序由 Intel 的程序改来，归 Intel XeSS SDK 条款。"XessFG Model 15 Final" 资料包的作者找到了把 model 15 改标成 model 16 的办法。

源码与构建

  • 代理、后端、测试与工具的 C++ 源码在源码仓库里，用 build.ps1 构建（默认运行库模型 310.9.16，-Runtime310916 指向运行库；-RuntimeModel 310.9 是开发用备选、配 -Runtime3109； -KernelPack 指向内核包），步骤、测试与提交规则见源码仓库的 CONTRIBUTING.md。
  • 内核包 dlssg_sm86\kernels\fg_kernels.dll、超分内核包、XeSS 模型包与 NVIDIA 运行库不在源码里，从同版本的发布包取。没有内核包时 Engine=DLSS 的帧生成 被拒绝（日志 kernel_pack_missing、fg_kernels_unavailable），不改用运行库自己的内核；没有 XeSS 模型包时 Engine=XeSS 拒绝插帧（xefg_unavailable，插帧关）。

许可与第三方

  • 本项目的 C++ 源码以 MIT 许可发布（LICENSE.md，Copyright (c) 2026 sdli1995）。随包提供的内核镜像只以二进制形式提供，不在 MIT 许可范围内。
  • 随包的 nvngx_dlssg.dll（310.9.16，SHA 前缀 cadee1aa…）以文件形式放在 dlssg_sm86\runtime\，超分 snippet nvngx_dlss.dll（310.9.16）放在 dlssg_sm86\sr\，均未经修改。内核包 dlssg_sm86\kernels\fg_kernels.dll 与 dlssg_sm86\sr\sr_kernels.dll 里的内核镜像由 NVIDIA 的内核提取、重编译或重写而来（sm_75 一族导入自 Coldwood1026），只以二进制形式提供，不在 MIT 许可范围内。这些都是 NVIDIA 及上游第三方材料，不随源码转授权，见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt。
  • dlssg_sm86\xefg\xefg_kernels.dll 里的着色器与权重来自 Intel XeSS-FG，按 Intel 的 MIT 许可随包，声明见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt。同一个 DLL 里的 model 15 程序取自 MFG-Unlocker 1.6.0（MIT）：其中 46 个由 Intel 的 XeSS SDK 程序改来，归 Intel XeSS SDK 条款，不在 MFG-Unlocker 的 MIT 与本项目的 LICENSE.md 之内。不包含 Intel 的 libxess_fg.dll。

item.title: faroukbmiled/RyukGram
item.description:
RyukGram, The Instagram tweak for iOS power users.

https://store.ryuksign.com

RyukGram

The Instagram tweak for iOS power users.

v1.5.1 · Instagram 453.0.0 | Instagram 410.1.0

The Instagram 410 build is for older iOS versions and trails the main build on newer features.

Issues · Translate · Features

Note

RyukGram is closed source for now and will open up again later. Builds and translations stay current here.

Install

Add it in one tap

Open it on your phone and everything is one tap away. Add it once and updates arrive on their own.

  • Sideload. Adds the source to Feather or RyukSign, SideStore, or AltStore. Pick the plugins build normally, or no plugins if you sign with a free Apple account, since free accounts cannot sign the bundled extensions.
  • Jailbreak. Adds the repo to Sileo or Zebra, then installs the build that matches your setup. To paste it by hand the repo is https://source.ryuksign.com/apt/.

Build your own IPA

Instagram itself cannot be bundled here, so you bring the Instagram IPA and the build slots RyukGram into it.

With GitHub Actions, no Mac needed. Fork this repo, open the Actions tab, and run Build sideloaded IPA from Release Assets. Give it your Instagram IPA and it hands back a patched IPA ready to sign and install. Turn on the no-plugins option if you sign with a free account.

Or by hand with a tool like cyan, injecting into your own Instagram IPA:

  • Regular build. Inject zxPluginsInject.dylib into the app and its plugins. The normal one, with the bundled extensions.
  • No-plugins build. Inject NoPluginsPatch.dylib instead. For a plugin free sideload, or a free account where extensions cannot be signed.

Download the .deb

Prefer the file? Both builds are on the latest release.

File Build
RyukGram_x.x.x_rootless.deb Rootless
RyukGram_x.x.x_rootful.deb Rootful

The rootless .deb also carries the dylib and bundle the sideload builds use.

TrollStore

Download RyukGram_trollfools.zip from the latest release and inject it into Instagram with TrollFools.

Once it is running, open the settings by holding the button at the top of your profile, or the home button in the tab bar. Screenshots are below.

Features

General

  • Hide ads and Meta AI
  • Hide the TestFlight popup and turn off app haptics
  • Always mute keeps everything silent until you tap a speaker or press volume
  • Copy captions, comments, and profile info, or select just part of the text
  • Download, copy, or expand image and GIF comments
  • Send any Giphy link as a comment GIF and pin your favorites
  • Download audio from the reels audio page or any music picker
  • Audio categories in every music picker: hold a song to file it, then play and pick from a row under the tabs
  • Clean shared links for embeds and strip tracking, with your own param list
  • Open links in an external browser or straight from the clipboard
  • Tappable links, emails and phone numbers in captions, comments and bios
  • Native color picker, teen app icons, and the bundled app icons
  • Liquid glass controls with a force off switch
  • Instagram Plus features, or just hide its upsells
  • Notes tweaks: hide the tray or friends map, custom themes
  • Hide suggested accounts and searches, trending, the explore grid, sensitive covers, and surveys
  • Compact save sheet that skips the empty collections prompt
  • Hide reels in explore
  • Stat pills on search and explore, picked and reordered by you
  • Anonymous live viewing and toggleable live comments
  • Redact RyukGram's buttons in screenshots and recordings
  • Update checker with release notes
  • Safari extension that opens any Instagram page in RyukGram and blocks app prompts
  • Crash logs you can search and share

Feed

  • Grid feed: your home feed as thumbnails with stats, columns, shapes, spacing, shading, rounded corners and date format of your choice
  • Hold a tile to preview, like, follow, expand, share, or copy the link
  • Switch back to Instagram's feed from the header or a floating button
  • Hide the stories tray, suggested stories, highlights, and live streams
  • View a profile picture from a story tray long press
  • Hide the whole feed, or just suggested posts, accounts, reels, threads, and Facebook cards
  • Cap posts in a row and filter by minimum likes, comments, views, or reposts
  • Turn off video autoplay
  • Hide the full screen button on feed videos
  • Play feed reels in place
  • Long press any media to open it full screen
  • Custom date format with relative times
  • Turn off background and home button refresh
  • Status bar tap scrolls up only, or does nothing
  • Stop the feed swipe from opening the camera
  • Confirm pull to refresh, or refresh only the stories tray
  • Reorder, hide, or drop the counts on post buttons

Reels

  • Custom tap controls and auto scroll that skips sponsored and photo reels
  • Hold controls for pause, the options menu, or picture in picture
  • Playback menu for speed, seek, next and previous, sound, and picture in picture
  • Action button, playback menu and menu button hold in the long video player
  • Always visible scrubber, no auto unmute, and refresh confirmation
  • Expanded view without cropped sides
  • Unlock password locked reels
  • Reorder, hide, or drop the counts on sidebar buttons
  • Hide the header, friend avatars, promo pills, the comment bar, and live streams
  • Swipe left to open the author's profile
  • Show the repost date
  • Disable reel scrolling
  • Reels limit per session or per day, with time or reel caps, chosen weekdays, reels-free days, a week chart, break nudges, and strict mode
  • Limited extra time with a daily cap and optional wait
  • Hide feed videos once a limit hits
  • Filter reels by minimum likes, comments, views, or reposts
  • Enhanced pause and play mode

Action buttons

  • Context aware menus on feed, reels, stories, DMs, and profiles
  • Configurable default tap and icon browser
  • Bulk download carousels and multiple stories
  • Save a photo post with its music as a video
  • Save a photo story as just the image
  • Repost through Instagram's own flow
  • Full screen viewer with zoom and swipe
  • Drag overlay buttons into place on a live preview, with size and spacing controls

Profile

  • Zoom or save the profile picture, and view every picture on the account
  • View highlight covers from a long press
  • Action button for info, the picture, and follower stats
  • Follows you back indicator in lists and on profiles
  • Copy notes and reveal full counts
  • Spoof your picture, username, name, bio, Threads handle, stats, badge, post metrics and story views on your device
  • Clone any profile into your spoof and keep it synced
  • Spoof multipliers that grow with the real count, with an optional base and random daily growth
  • Hide the Threads button
  • Sort and search follower and following lists
  • Follow request tracker, even for requests canceled before you answer
  • Confirm or decline follow requests in bulk, with a warning before asking someone who declined you

Profile analyzer

  • Follower and following scans with mutuals and non followbacks
  • New and lost trackers across scans
  • Change history for name, username, bio, and picture
  • Inline and batch follow, unfollow, and remove
  • Private log of profiles you open, with notes, filters and export
  • Watchlist that checks accounts on a schedule
  • Tracked changes for username, name, bio, links, picture, privacy, follow back and counts, with alerts per type
  • Watchlist saves new stories, posts, reels and profile pictures to the gallery
  • Per check toggles and a badge for gains and losses

Saving

  • HD downloads up to 1080p with a quality picker and preview
  • Full resolution photos, or pick the size
  • Audio only and raw photo options
  • Save, share, or copy any sticker, animated ones included
  • Save all media from any profile by count or date range, queued with a daily limit
  • Download manager with live speed, filters, and bulk select
  • Download history with redownload
  • Duplicate check before saving the same media twice
  • Auto retry for dropped downloads
  • Save into a dedicated RyukGram album
  • Advanced encoding for codec, bitrate, and resolution
  • Consistent filenames stamped with the post date, with an optional ryuk_ prefix
  • Optional download confirmation

Gallery

  • Private in-app library for every download
  • Images, video, audio, and animated GIFs
  • Filter by type, source, uploader, date, favorites, and folders
  • Sort by date, name, or size
  • Group by user into sections or folders, from 2 to 5 columns
  • Posts and stories stay one swipeable album, which you can group or split
  • Import your own photos, videos and files
  • Pick from it inside Instagram to send or post several at once
  • Repost any photo, video or GIF as a story, post or reel
  • Edit photos, videos, audio and GIFs, saved as new or over the original
  • Info page with source details, camera and codec info, and location removal
  • Upgrade saved media to HD
  • Save a folder or the whole view to Photos
  • Deleted filter for saved posts and stories removed from Instagram

Stories and messages

  • Keep deleted messages, including your own unsends, marked how you like
  • Searchable log of every unsent message, with a jump to where it sat
  • Catch view-once media that arrives while Instagram is closed
  • Log view-once media when you open it
  • Activity notifications for reads, online, offline, and typing, per person
  • Activity log as a filterable timeline
  • Accurate active status
  • Story playback menu for speed, seek, next and previous, sound, and picture in picture
  • Your own fonts in the story text tool
  • Manual and automatic mark as seen
  • Hold the eye button to mark a whole story reel seen, or up to where you are
  • Mark chats seen on your device only
  • Seen stories hide or tint the eye button for 48 hours
  • Send audio as a file or voice note, with a trim editor
  • Send an image as your doodle in Draw
  • Download voice messages
  • Force the missing sound toggle in the DM camera
  • Turn off typing status, the vanish swipe, and view once limits
  • Pick the score you send in the DM emoji game
  • Hide shared reels in chats
  • Toggle your activity status from the DMs inbox
  • Custom chat backgrounds from an image, video, or GIF
  • Filter, sort, search, and pin story viewers, with their reactions
  • Archive your own stories with their viewers, plus story stats
  • View story mentions and reveal poll and quiz results
  • Bypass Reveal stickers and pick custom sticker colors
  • Cutout stickers from the gallery
  • Story backgrounds in any color or gradient
  • Long videos post to stories as back to back parts, not trimmed
  • Download disappearing DM media in full quality
  • Hide the views toggle and keep views blocked
  • Send Instants from your album, with crop and trim
  • Auto close the Instants viewer
  • Toggle the Instants switch confirmation from the viewer
  • Keep Instants unseen until you mark them seen
  • Record voice and video calls, browsed per person
  • Save, share, or delete recordings in bulk, or share them as audio only

Interface

  • Custom notification sounds for DMs and other alerts
  • Hide Instagram's in-app banners
  • Notification pill you can place anywhere
  • Mirror notifications to the iOS notification center
  • Reorder and hide tab bar icons on a live preview
  • Native iOS liquid glass tab bar on iOS 26 with 5 tabs or fewer
  • Add RyukGram screens, Saved and Activity as tabs, and pick the launch tab
  • Hold any tab to open a RyukGram screen
  • Messages-only mode on a schedule, for a set time, or from Shortcuts links
  • Shortcuts links to switch Messages-only and Reels limit from iOS automations, or from a file without opening Instagram
  • Force Instagram into any supported language
  • Home shortcut button with new item badges, also shown on added tabs
  • Notification history with filters and search
  • Bring back the old Instagram logo
  • Instagram feature flags browser to read, change, export and import Instagram's internal MobileConfig settings
  • Every MobileConfig config named, with notes, search, and new ones marked per update
  • Record which configs Instagram reads during any action

Confirm actions

  • Optional confirmations for likes, follows, reposts, calls, comments, and more
  • Confirm DM reactions

Fake location

  • Override your location with a map picker and saved presets

Theme

  • Off, light, dark, or OLED, applied to Instagram only
  • OLED chat theme and matching keyboard
  • Custom fonts for Instagram, RyukGram, or both
  • Import your own fonts, or download from thousands online
  • Custom emoji fonts
  • Manage installed fonts in bulk

Security and privacy

  • Mask the device identifiers Instagram reads
  • Passcode and biometric lock for settings, chats, logs, recordings, and the app
  • Hidden chats with per account lists, optionally kept out of the share sheet
  • App switcher shroud and hidden previews for locked chats

Backup and profiles

  • Export settings and feature data as JSON or an encrypted bundle
  • Restore with replace or merge, scoped to the accounts you pick or into a new profile
  • Save your setup as a named profile and switch in a tap
  • Name, color, duplicate, or share profiles as files
  • Tie a profile to Instagram accounts so it switches with them
  • Reset a profile or turn everything off in it
  • See and clear what RyukGram keeps on your device

Localization

  • English, Spanish, French, Russian, Korean, Japanese, Arabic, Vietnamese, Chinese, Portuguese, Turkish, Indonesian, and Slovak
  • In app language picker

Optimization

  • Clear the Instagram cache on demand or on a timer
  • Instagram API controls to reuse replies, pace requests, and cap daily actions and scans

Translating

Want RyukGram in your language? Export the strings from Settings, Debug, Localization, translate the right side of each "key" = "value"; line, and open a pull request with your file at src/Localization/Resources/<code>.lproj/Localizable.strings. Keep the format specifiers like %@ and %lu exactly as they are. Missing lines fall back to English, so partial work is welcome. Anything you contribute is licensed to the project under the same terms as RyukGram.

Opening settings

Credits

RyukGram got its start from SCInsta by @SoCuul, and I'm grateful for the foundation it gave the project. That code has since been fully rewritten and none of it remains, so RyukGram is its own separate codebase. It went closed source because earlier releases were being lifted and resold as paid tweaks, which is something I can't keep feeding, and I know some of you valued it staying open. Thanks to @SoCuul and the wider iOS tweak scene for paving the way.

  • @BandarHL for BHInstagram
  • @VAXMG for OLED theme inspiration
  • @euoradan for experiment flag research
  • @n3d1117 for the Following feed
  • BillyCurtis for the Safari extension base
  • @asdfzxcvbn for ipapatch and zxPluginsInject
  • Furamako, @ZomkaDEV, @ch1tmdgus, @hooray804, @bruuhim, @jaydenjcpy, @brunorainha, @yesnt10, @tranbinh02, @yannouuuu, @willybilly981, @diemasmahendra, and @dddaaadddooo for translations

Support

If RyukGram earns a spot on your phone, you can keep it going here.
